According to the table given above, which country has the maximum number of positive cases
solution:
**Calculation:**

Positive cases in the US = 14000 × 12%

⇒ 1680

Positive cases in Spain = 12000 × 8%

⇒ 960

Positive cases in Italy = 10000 × 12%

⇒ 1200

Positive cases in China = 10000 × 11%

⇒ 1100

So, the maximum number of positive cases is in the US

**∴ The required answer is the US.**
